description: This file defines the interface and data structures for the TinySRP client-side implementation of the SRP (Secure Remote Password) authentication protocol, including the t_client class, its methods, and related constants.

classes.name: t_client
classes.description: Structure representing the SRP client state, including cryptographic parameters, user credentials, and session data.

methods.name: t_clientopen
methods.description: Initializes a new SRP client session with username and parameters N, g, s.

methods.name: t_clientgenexp
methods.description: Generates a random 256-bit exponent and computes g raised to that power.

methods.name: t_clientpasswd
methods.description: Sets the user's password in the client state.

methods.name: t_clientgetkey
methods.description: Computes the session key from the server's exponential y(p).

methods.name: t_clientresponse
methods.description: Computes the session key proof for authentication.

methods.name: t_clientclose
methods.description: Closes the SRP client session and frees resources.
